items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They had this fellow, they call him Red Dog Franklin or something? Henry Dog. [INTERVIEWEE] Henry Dog.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I don't care about him much because he's got a big cab from there. He got a lot of cabs. And then he got that job, too. But we tried to get him in the Eureka band. Mm-hmm. We all went to the rehearsal and all. He didn't all come in. We played the music for him. I said, go ahead and ask the other one. He said, but I can make it. I said, I know you can make it.
They had two clarinets uptown with the Gibson the last time I saw them. Yeah. They had this fellow, they call him Red Dog Franklin or something? Henry Dog.
